purpose: Approachable, expressive black-and-white logo alternatives for The Unbound Launcher

options.name: 05 / SOFT LOOP
options.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create one polished black-and-white logo concept for The Unbound Launcher, a spatial Android launcher for AR glasses. This new exploration should feel approachable, imaginative and spacious.
Asset type: one concept on a clean landscape presentation board. Show a large primary horizontal logo on white in the upper two thirds, plus a smaller white-on-black version and a standalone app-icon symbol on a black strip in the lower third. Generous whitespace, careful optical balance, crisp flat vector-like artwork. Pure black and white only.
Brand wording must be exactly THE UNBOUND LAUNCHER, with case and hierarchy specified below. UNBOUND is spelled U N B O U N D. All text must be legible.
Put only the concept number and name specified below in small neutral type at the upper left, plus the brand wording in the logos. No extra captions or taglines. Avoid industrial styling, stencil lettering, scanlines, military motifs, hardware markings, harsh chamfers, 3D, gradients, shadows, gray tones, grain, product mockups or decorative backgrounds.
Concept label: "05 / SOFT LOOP".
Direction: a friendly flowing U symbol constructed from one broad, soft continuous curve, nearly circular in its bowl, with rounded terminals and one arm rising subtly above the other. The silhouette should feel like an open embrace or a relaxed loop opening into space. Strong simple negative space, no tiny details, no arrow. Pair it with a carefully drawn lowercase rounded geometric sans wordmark "unbound"; small "the" above and widely spaced "launcher" below. The typography should feel soft and confident with open counters, not childish. Charming, quiet, contemporary, approachable.
